functional_unit: one household in one dwelling/site/tenure configuration over a declared occupancy horizon, with equivalent essential services and access requirements

tenure_models.scope: Land/title, deposit, finance, rates/levies, insurance, maintenance and eventual adaptation.
Rent, deposits, utility obligations, escalation, tenant rights, maintenance responsibility and relocation risk.
Share purchase/contribution, governance, common costs, exit rights, finance and maintenance obligations.
Rent, purchase option, credited payments, price reset, default and exit rules; legal review required.
Land/tenure, service connections, phase-specific safe occupancy, construction and future adaptation.

scenarios.mutation: Matched service, location, household and time horizon.
Increase financing rate under a declared stress path.
Increase water/electricity/waste tariffs and service charges.
Introduce outage, tanker/back-up cost or reduced service.
Increase commute duration/cost or remove a transit connection.
Reduce or interrupt household disposable income using a declared stress case.
Introduce a major component/system repair or replacement.
Delay title, land release, servitude or permit resolution.
Set utility connection capacity/availability to UNKNOWN or insufficient.
Add a future room or service demand and recheck full cost and service floors.

hard_gates.meaning: All material cost rows carry source, unit, region, date, tax/delivery scope and uncertainty.
No unknown cost is silently coerced to zero.
No unknown/inadequate connection or bulk capacity is represented as delivered service.
No insecure or unresolved tenure is represented as secure/approved.
No site/household claim is inferred from national averages alone.
No low-cost option offsets a breached essential water/sanitation/access/safety floor.
Known-feasible cases remain admissible; an always-blocked system does not pass.

comparators.scope: Quantity surveyor / contractor estimate for matched design scope, with fees, exclusions, date and contingency.
Site and development feasibility, not household lifecycle affordability.
Debt repayment only; not land, services, transport, maintenance or service floors.
Versioned subsidy/serviced-site rules; eligibility is not inferred.
Manual cost-of-place baseline with transparent formulas and source data.
Resident brief plus cost, tenure, utility, transport, lifecycle and owner evidence.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic whole-household affordability research contract. No individual affordability, credit eligibility, site readiness or savings result is present.
